evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Combines broad search/discovery behavior with multiple identification methods, making scope too coarse to estimate reliably.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile basis and discovery behavior are underspecified; scope is too broad to plan and estimate.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similarity between users is undefined and search/discovery scope is broad.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Multiple media outputs and vague content-similarity behavior make the requirement coarse-grained.

evaluations.evidence: related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path
evaluations.rationale: Open-ended outputs and broad metadata-based discovery make estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Similarity and requested information are unspecified, allowing very different implementation scopes.

evaluations.evidence: perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity narrows the retrieval behavior enough to estimate a coherent feature.

evaluations.evidence: content recommendations from similar profiles
